subject_group: 6.2.10 Vehicle control function air data safety

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that ice prevention measures are safe. Standard: Air data ice prevention is provided by heaters. This protection is provided wherever the probes/sensors are located. Design does not allow the entrapment of moisture that can result in the formation of ice. Built-In-Test (BIT) determines the health of the air data ice prevention components. Redundancy in ice prevention, including power sources, is provided to meet air data system requirements on safe integration with VCF (see 6.2.4.2, this document). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, inspection and review of documentation. The VCF air data ice prevention functions are verified through test including FMET, ground, and flight tests for the anticipated environments. References: JSSG-2008: 3.1, 3.1.11.6, 3.1.11.11.2, 3.1.14.1, 3.1.14.2.5, 3.1.14.7, 3.2.2.4, associated section 4 paragraphs. 14 CFR 23.775, 23.1189, 23.1323, 23.1325, 23.1416, 23.1419, 25.21, 25.207, 25.1323, 25.1325, 25.1419, 27.1323, 27.1325, 27.1419, 29.773, 29.1189, 29.1323, 29.1325, 29.1419.

Standard: Air data ice prevention and removal is provided. This protection is provided wherever the probes or sensors are located. Design does not allow the entrapment of moisture that can result in the formation of ice. The health of air data ice prevention is monitored and failures are identified and presented to flight crew. Redundancy in ice prevention, including power sources, is provided to meet air data system requirements when integrated with the VCF. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review documentation of design specifications for air data sources to ensure the design prevents ice accumulation and facilitates removal of ice. Analysis.
  (1) Verify that the ice prevention and removal method will function normally with primary or backup power sources. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct qualification tests on all air data components for exposure to icing conditions.
    (2) Lab test: Verify that the ice prevention and removal method removes ice that has accumulated and prevents buildup of ice when active.
    (3) Lab test: Conduct FMET of air data icing protection and verify failures due to exposure to icing conditions are presented to the flight crew.
    (4) Lab test: Conduct component-level test to confirm ice prevention and removal capability functions when powered.
